objective: Calibrate a one-row-per-cycle 16-bit by 16-center nearest-pattern matcher in Synopsys VCS, with tau0 as the exact hardware subset and tau1 as the only lossy extension.

hardware_contract.population_guard: patterns with population below two are never snapped
hardware_contract.tau0_semantics: only distance-zero exact hits may select a catalog center
hardware_contract.tau1_semantics: distance-zero exact hits and distance-one positive-distance matches may select a catalog center
hardware_contract.interface: single-entry elastic ready/valid; one accepted row and one retired row per cycle under continuous ready
hardware_contract.center_storage: 256-bit center bundle is an input; physical metadata SRAM is outside this calibration module

red_lines: VCS success cannot promote the M309 lossy point before paired valid825 passes.
The center input bus is not a zero-cost physical SRAM implementation.
Do not call isolated matcher II a complete Conv or system speedup.
